name: @bunest/drizzle
description: Drizzle ORM integration for Bunest with 100% @nestjs/drizzle API parity, automatic client shutdown, and @bunest/sql ALS transaction integration

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --format esm --external @bunest/common --external @bunest/core --external @bunest/sql --external reflect-metadata --external bun:sqlite
